properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.hub-openapi.enabled
properties.description: Whether the OpenAPI hub is active. It aggregates the contracts of the services the gateway discovers, and lights up the OpenAPI view of the UI. Opt-in: unlike the other plugins, the hub does nothing until it is explicitly turned on.

properties.name: spring.cloud.gateway.server.webflux.hub-openapi.security-chain-enabled
properties.description: Whether the hub contributes its own security filter chain, permitting the exact paths the aggregated contracts are served on. Turn it off to secure those paths from the application instead.
